sources.title: Models | Aion Labs Docs
sources.evidence: The exact Aion 3.0 entry describes GLM-family models jointly generating responses for narrative use and explicitly dates release to 2026-05-05.

sources.title: Aion Labs public models API
sources.evidence: Exact ID aion-labs/aion-3.0 has name AionLabs: Aion 3.0, date 2026-05-05, context_length 131072, text-to-text modality, reasoning true and tool_calls true. No component identities or parameter counts are supplied.

sources.title: API Reference | Aion Labs Docs
sources.evidence: Defines catalog dates as release dates and documents per-model reasoning/tool capability flags. Aion 3.0 accepts none, low, medium, high or max reasoning effort, with medium as default.

sources.title: Terms of Service | Aion Labs
sources.evidence: Current terms identify the Aion Labs brand with Deep Forge sp. z o.o. Section 6 grants model usage through the service but no other model rights; this is an API service agreement, not a released-weight license.

sources.title: Aion Labs models on Hugging Face
sources.evidence: Official organization links to aionlabs.ai and lists only the Aion-RP Llama 3.1 8B checkpoint and GGUF variant. No Aion 3.0 model card or weights appear there.

sources.title: Aion-3.0 | OpenRouter
sources.evidence: The serving-platform listing labels July 7, 2026 as release, conflicting with the original developer date. Used to record this date conflict, not to infer architecture or counts.

sources.title: Models.dev Aion 3.0 record
sources.evidence: Baseline-linked catalog entry was accessed as a discovery lead; primary developer documentation and API were separately inspected.

name.note: Use developer spelling after removing its display-name vendor prefix.

developer.note: Developer brand is Aion Labs; legal service operator is Deep Forge sp. z o.o.

family.note: GLM lineage is explicit; the precise component versions are unspecified.

release_date.note: Original developer explicitly reports May 5. OpenRouter reports July 7; retain the developer date and record the platform discrepancy.

open_weights.note: API access is verified, but the inspected primary pages do not explicitly classify this exact system as closed. No Aion 3.0 weights/card were found in the official Hugging Face listing; absence alone does not prove non-release.

license.note: No model-weight license was identified. Service terms are not evidence of a separately distributed checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: No Aion 3.0 total parameter count or component inventory is disclosed in the inspected developer sources. Do not import a GLM base-model count.

active_parameters_b.note: No system-wide or per-component active parameter count is disclosed; collaborative generation does not establish a per-token active count.

architecture.note: Verified at system level: several specialized models contribute to responses. Neural-layer architecture, component count, and dense/MoE composition remain undisclosed; this label does not assert those details.

context_window.note: Exact context_length in the live developer API, in tokens.

modalities.note: The exact API record declares text-to-text modality.

reasoning.note: Exact capability flag is true; reasoning can be disabled through reasoning_effort=none.

tool_call.note: Exact capability flag tool_calls is true, with its API semantics documented.

description.value: GLM-based multi-model system for narrative generation, with collaborative response generation, reasoning, and tool calling.
description.note: Replace the generic analytical-use description with the documented system and intended narrative use; omit unsupported quality comparisons.

patch.name: Aion 3.0
patch.description: GLM-based multi-model system for narrative generation, with collaborative response generation, reasoning, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Developer describes a GLM-family collaborative multi-model system, without identifying component versions, total/active parameter counts, or dense/MoE composition. No Aion 3.0 weight release or weight license was verified. Developer release date is 2026-05-05; OpenRouter instead labels 2026-07-07 as release.

summary: Corrects name formatting, GLM lineage, system-level architecture and narrative-use description. Confirms developer release date and API capabilities. Total/active parameter counts and component architectures remain undisclosed. Open-weight status is unverified and therefore set to null; model-weight license remains null. Records the conflicting OpenRouter date.
